summary: Stage A read-only diagnosis and regression design complete. Main remains exactly 175ad976a6226f1cb07901b4b43f3d6b0ecf3de1. The reported failure is caused by conflating a manual tab's authorization lifetime with its current URL/document: main's manual registration path requires tab.url === boundUrl and observeNavigation permanently blocks on any URL change, including same-origin navigation. The extension-only candidate at c849ffa1d085006417d0603c5ff2f643139fdbd4 separates origin-scoped authorization from page identity, pins the active documentId and route revision at extension receipt, targets userScripts.execute by documentIds, and returns OutcomeUnknown after a dispatched operation crosses a route/document change. It still cannot fence a delayed client-selected request because the client does not supply the identity it selected; the candidate's own live-smoke note explicitly limits evidence to extension-receipt fencing. No source/test files were edited and no tests or live browser operations were run in this turn. Stage B remains blocked.

End-to-end gap: Client/Modules/BrowserBridge.fs ListTabs returns cloned registration catalog; Execute sends only registrationId/registrationGeneration; CaptureDom sends only registrationId/registrationGeneration; snapshotChunk sends only snapshotId/offset. Common/Messages/AgentCommand.fs records BrowserExecuteFileCommand, BrowserExecuteJsCommand, BrowserCaptureDomCommand and BrowserExportDomCommand carry no page identity. Client/SignalR/Client.fs dispatches these operations using only tabRegistration. Required fix is a separate opaque document-route token advertised in the tab catalog and captured at client selection, passed as an expected token through Execute/ExecuteFile/CaptureDom/ExportDom and echoed/validated on all wire responses and snapshot chunks. It must bind registrationId+generation+active document+route revision+worker instance; rotate on navigation/worker restart without changing same-origin authorization generation; reject stale tokens before dispatch and preserve OutcomeUnknown/no-replay after dispatch. Focused tests: stale selected token after delayed navigation; full-document same-origin fresh token; SPA/history/fragment and ABA route; same-URL reload; cross-origin sticky reauthorization; permission removal/regrant; preflight race; in-flight effect exactly once; stale snapshot chunk; worker restart; agent-created launcher behavior unchanged.
